content: uuidgenerator.net: generates UUID immediately on load (zero-effort benchmark), supports v1/v3/v4/v5/v7 separately (dedicated pages per version), bulk/batch generation with download-to-file, and an API for automated generation. Table-stakes across UUID generator sites: instant default result, copy button, bulk generation, version selection (v4 near-universal default). Format toggles (case, hyphens, output format CSV/JSON) are less universal -- a differentiator opportunity, already scoped into this brief.
